WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, s.store_id,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS ord_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN disp_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN receipt_id END) AS orders_by_dispatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN disp_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN net_amount END) AS net_by_dispatch,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ord_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN receipt_id END) AS orders_by_orderdate,
 sum(CASE WHEN ord_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN net_amount END) AS net_by_orderdate,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN receipt_id END) AS orders_by_saledate,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN net_amount END) AS net_by_saledate,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date <> ord_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saledate_ne_orderdate,
 sum(CASE WHEN disp_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_no_order
FROM lines

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS nb
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date AS d, store_id, receipts, net_sales_before_returns AS nb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE store_id<900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT count(*) AS store_days, sum(CASE WHEN m.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_ctl, sum(CASE WHEN c.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_mine,
 sum(m.receipts) AS my_receipts, sum(c.receipts) AS ctl_receipts, sum(m.nb) AS my_nb, sum(c.nb) AS ctl_nb,
 sum(CASE WHEN m.receipts<>c.receipts OR abs(m.nb-c.nb)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.d=m.d AND c.store_id=m.store_id

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-05-04' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-02' AS end_date   -- FY2026/27 P1-P3
),
sales AS (
    -- stores: dated by Helsinki sale_date; web (store 900): dated by Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT f.receipt_id,
           f.net_amount,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900
                THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
                ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id < 999
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, '1 to 3' AS periods,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM sales CROSS JOIN params
WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-05-04' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-02' AS end_date   -- FY2026/27 P1 to P3
),
store_lines AS (
    -- physical stores: dated by Helsinki sale_date; staff purchases and test articles out
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
),
web_lines AS (
    -- web shop (store 900): dated by Helsinki dispatch date; sale_date prefilter only narrows the scan
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date - 60 AND params.end_date
      AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
),
all_lines AS (
    SELECT receipt_id, net_amount, 'store' AS part FROM store_lines
    UNION ALL
    SELECT receipt_id, net_amount, 'web' FROM web_lines
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, '1 to 3' AS periods,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='store' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='store' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS store_atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='web' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='web' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS web_atv
FROM all_lines
